hero.lede: CHRON.OS helps people and teams build archives that remember where files came from, why they matter, and when they need attention — without making the cloud the source of truth.

console.releaseBody: Installer, MSI, and self-contained portable ZIP are available for Windows.

pipeline.label: Source
pipeline.description: Original path and intake context remain visible.

pipeline.label: Hash
pipeline.description: Every artifact gets a cryptographic anchor.

pipeline.label: Metadata
pipeline.description: Sidecar facts stay local and inspectable.

pipeline.label: Meaning
pipeline.description: User-weighted context can evolve over time.

capabilities.title: Capture
capabilities.copy: Copy important files into a working archive without mutating originals.

capabilities.title: Provenance
capabilities.copy: Preserve source paths, hashes, sidecar metadata, and intake context.

capabilities.title: Govern
capabilities.copy: Track age, context, search posture, and review-ready archive state.

capabilities.title: Stage
capabilities.copy: Keep automation, retention, and interop behind explicit gates.

audiences.title: Individuals
audiences.copy: Recover messy downloads, old documents, scattered project files, research folders, and forgotten archives without losing where they came from.
audiences.label: Personal archive recovery

audiences.title: Teams
audiences.copy: Preserve provenance, review aging files, standardize archive rules, and prepare policy-based retention workflows before automation is enabled.
audiences.label: Operational file custody

audiences.title: Organizations
audiences.copy: Use CHRON.OS as the archive layer inside a broader local-first Hyperion deployment, with deeper interop lanes staged until policy and trust gates are ready.
audiences.label: Local-first archive layer

publicBeta: durable photo, video, and audio intake
approved watched sources and Quick Intake
staged: cloud, NAS, and production OAuth polish
speaker diarization and deeper media models
unbounded media processing beyond beta resource guards

services.name: Archive Assessment
services.copy: A bounded review of the archive, failure mode, custody posture, and first recovery sequence.

services.name: CHR0N.OS Setup
services.copy: A guided local installation, initial archive structure, and operator handoff for one workstation.

services.name: Archive Migration
services.copy: A reviewed migration plan for scattered files and project records, with provenance preserved.

services.name: Team Continuity Setup
services.copy: A scoped team archive and handoff system with ownership, retention, and support boundaries.

videoLanes.title: Intake in motion
videoLanes.copy: See four fictional files stage, enter the durable queue, and complete metadata-only intake while the originals remain untouched.

videoLanes.title: Archive after intake
videoLanes.copy: Follow ten fictional artifacts into the Archive date lane, then filter the ingested library to its technical records.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 archive overview in an isolated empty demo workspace

panels.label: Honest first-run state
panels.copy: Zero indexed files, zero proposals, and no invented activity in the isolated demo workspace.

panels.label: Working copies
panels.copy: The current build states the custody model up front: import copies and sidecars without rewriting originals.

panels.label: Vault posture
panels.copy: The interface warns when local settings and index data are not yet sealed instead of hiding the condition.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 durable queue after completing fictional Project Aurora intake files

panels.label: Durable queue
panels.copy: Four synthetic sources move from local staging into completed durable jobs in seconds.

panels.label: Visible evidence
panels.copy: Each result shows its working-copy classification, format, tags, and completion state.

panels.label: Synthetic and local
panels.copy: The capture uses fictional Project Aurora records in an isolated archive with metadata-only processing.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 local engine and parser capability posture

panels.label: Probe before processing
panels.copy: OCR, decoding, vision, and transcription report their packaged posture before intake starts.

panels.label: No silent cloud fallback
panels.copy: A missing local engine stays unavailable; CHR0N.OS does not silently replace it with cloud processing.

panels.label: Explicit beta state
panels.copy: Model-missing, metadata-only, and unavailable capabilities remain visible to the operator.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 timeline showing ten fictional artifacts in the Archive date lane

panels.label: Separate date lanes
panels.copy: Source, archive, inferred, unknown, correction, suggestion, and policy events stay distinguishable.

panels.label: Ingest evidence
panels.copy: Ten synthetic artifacts appear in the operator-visible Archive date lane after intake.

panels.label: Honest empty lanes
panels.copy: Unused inferred, correction, suggestion, policy, and external-context lanes remain at zero.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 library showing fictional Project Aurora artifacts after intake

panels.label: Working-copy catalog
panels.copy: The library brings ingested artifacts, formats, tags, and meaning posture into one review surface.

panels.label: Useful filtering
panels.copy: A technical dimension narrows the synthetic archive to its CSV and JSON records.

panels.label: Review remains explicit
panels.copy: Inferred context is presented as reviewable metadata, not silent publication or source mutation.

gallery.alt: CHR0N.OS v0.2.3 Archivist workspace in an isolated empty demo archive

panels.label: Archive-aware assistant
panels.copy: Ask Archivist to find files, explain structure, or review organization from one workspace.

panels.label: Empty archive honesty
panels.copy: The current build reports that zero files are indexed and avoids fabricating archive context.

panels.label: Public beta capture
panels.copy: Captured directly from v0.2.3 build 20260728-public-media-intake-v1 using an isolated empty workspace.

release.recommendation: Recommended for most Windows users: one-click installer. MSI and self-contained portable options are also available.

footer.description: CHRON.OS — local-first archival intelligence. A Hyperion Industries system.
